about_the_game:
Daniel wakes up to the same nightmare every night. A girl who will not let him go. When he discovers a missing child report that connects her to his childhood home, he is forced to return to a place filled with unsettling memories and terrifying games he once played with the boy next door.

What begins as a search for truth quickly becomes a descent into blurred memories and creeping dread. The line between reality and nightmare starts to unravel as Daniel pieces together fragments of the past, unsure if he is solving a case or falling deeper into his own delusion.

Key Features

  • Psychological horror with a focus on story and atmosphere

  • A haunting narrative filled with mystery, memory, and fear

  • Explore a childhood home twisted by nightmare logic

  • Uncover clues through unsettling children’s games

  • An immersive experience designed to blur the line between dream and reality

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all ages, including depictions of psychological horror, anxiety, and themes of childhood trauma. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (1.6 GHz, 1.8 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9740H (2.6 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570 (or better)
